segments.he: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: אֲפִילּוּ בָּא בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִמָּקוֹם קָרוֹב — מוֹנֶה עִמָּהֶן. אָמַר רַבִּי חִיָּיא בַּר גַּמָּדָא אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹסֵי בֶּן שָׁאוּל אָמַר רַבִּי: וְהוּא שֶׁבָּא וּמָצָא מְנַחֲמִין אֶצְלוֹ.
segments.en: § The Gemara cites the baraita taught above: «Rabbi Shimon says: Even» if one of the mourners «came on the seventh day from a nearby place, he counts with» the other mourners and completes the seven-day period of mourning with them. «Rabbi Ḥiyya bar Gamda said that Rabbi Yosei ben Shaul said that Rabbi» Yehuda HaNasi «said: And this is» the halakha, provided that «he came and found consolers» still present «in the house.»
